recipe.visualDefinition: A close-up, slightly angled male portrait set against a dark, textured blue background, featuring heavy, distressed orange typography in the lower right quadrant.
coreVisualRelationships: High-contrast complementary color scheme using deep indigo and vibrant orange.
Subject positioned off-center to the left, creating a visual weight balance with the text on the right.
Rough, industrial texture in the background mirroring the distressed treatment of the lettering.
coreInvariants: Indigo-blue color wash over the background and shadows.
Distressed, stencil-like or stamped typographic texture.
Direct, intense eye contact from the subject.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The subject's face occupies the left two-thirds of the frame, cropped at the shoulders and top of the head.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's eyes serve as the primary anchor, with the bright orange text acting as the secondary focal point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The viewer's eye starts at the subject's face, moves down to the large orange text, and then across the smaller subtitle text at the bottom.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The right side of the frame provides dark, textured negative space to accommodate the graphic elements.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep indigo and navy blue (background and shadows).
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Warm skin tones with natural highlights.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the orange text against a low-value, moody blue background.
paletteRestrictions: Limit the palette to blue, orange, and natural skin tones.

letterConstructionRules: Blocky, thick strokes with minimal curves.
Intentional 'eroded' or 'stamped' texture within the letterforms.
Horizontal gaps or 'stencil' cuts in vertical strokes.
characterSpecificRedesigns: Letters are unevenly distressed to simulate old print or street art stencils.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single font family used in two different scales (large for name, small for title).

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy weight and condensed nature.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a close-up portrait of a man with short dark hair, looking intensely at the camera. Apply a deep blue color grade and a gritty, textured wall background. Leave the bottom right area clear for text.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add two lines of large, all-caps, distressed orange text in the bottom right corner. Below that, add a third line of smaller, similarly styled orange text.

verificationChecks: Is the text orange and distressed?
Is the background predominantly dark blue and textured?
Is the subject off-center to the left?

adjustableVariables: Intensity of the blue color grade
Level of distress on the typography
mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the original artist
Any specific logos or brand marks
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the orange text is legible despite the distress.
Check that the blue tint doesn't wash out the skin tones completely.
Verify the 'stamped' look of the typography.
Confirm the composition feels weighted toward the bottom right.
recipe.reuseFormula: Portrait subject (left) + Textured blue background + Distressed orange all-caps typography (bottom right) = Early 2000s Grunge Pop Aesthetic.
